binary_policy: No new binary is committed. Paths below identify already tracked sources or future transient captures; the independent actor must verify hashes before judging.

UIX03_step_8.question: Which opaque candidate better preserves inventory structure: density, category breadth, weight/value visibility, and the item-detail-panel relationship? Do not score art style or infer provenance.
preparation: Crop only to the inventory window and its item-detail relationship.
Replace every label and proper noun with equal-length neutral blocks; retain numeric column widths but replace values.
Scale both candidates onto equal opaque 1920x1080 grounds without stretching.
Randomise A/B outside the judge context; store the sealed mapping separately; reveal only after response is final.

UIX04_JU12.question: Which sealed journal candidate reads as a chronological record rather than a quest-management dashboard?
preparation: do not expose automatic JU scores before judgement
